question: Introducing Reshma to a guest, a lady, Karishma, said, “She is the daughter of my father-in-law’s daughter”. How is Reshma related to Karishma?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24da8914664d10453c9d9ab26b8ab431f913e3fc49dcd23b79b6043ac90be683.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c2750b5346b75ee18f70d7932b7d99033967ff70a48d5bd451b3aa1cf99a116.png] 

Clearly, Reshma is the niece of Karishma.

Hence, ‘**Niece**’ is the correct answer.
